text: Water-soluble fertilizers fed through the drip line are preferred over ordinary granular fertilizer for cucumber because they dissolve and move through the soil faster, matching the crop's fast nutrient uptake and giving quicker growth response. Products referenced: Urea (46-0-0), MAP (12-61-0), Calcium nitrate (15.5-0-0 +26 CaO), Magnesium sulfate/MgSO4 (16-0-0 +16 MgO), and Muriate of potash/KCl (0-0-61). Nutrient demand shifts by growth stage — roughly P > N > K > Ca during germination/establishment, N = P = K > Ca during vegetative growth, P > K > N > Ca during flowering/fruiting, and K > N > Ca once fruit are maturing — so the fertigation schedule increases K relative to N as the crop moves into fruiting.
